Players Committee card image of [[Nute Gunray (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “During battle, may cancel game text of a Republic character with ability < 4 present. If with your Republic character (or character with 'Trade Federation' in lore), may add one battle destiny. Immune to attrition < 3.” Uploaded unchanged.
